description: Prospective generalization study with 24 newly frozen offboarding episodes across six preregistered strata; preserves v5 causal controls and strict accounting while adding exogenous authoritative evidence refresh.

design.primary_comparison: delegable episode set at fixed attention/risk/delivery budget
design.note: No episode is copied from v5; all identifiers, hidden truths, public evidence packets, and recovery schedules are frozen before real-model generation.
